summary: PR 1128 is test-only hardening, not an original-issue fix. It changes no production or native code, and its exact six-test regression passes unchanged on the recorded base as well as at the candidate commit. The reported ModelSlim checkpoint, Ascend/CANN execution, two-node TP32/DP4 serving topology, and response accuracy remain unavailable and unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's exact six test functions passed 6/6 before applying the candidate, proving they are not a failing-before regression for the reported issue.
The same six synthetic fused-QKV mapping, scale-ordering, and config cases passed 6/6 at exact commit 9f5b71e3aae3ad3a53b8c36683fd4d760c8cb22e.
There is no production Python or native-kernel delta in the candidate.

tests.command: prepared Python GPU check of _deinterleave_qkv_shards against an independently constructed reference
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, synthetic shards mapped to [1,2,5,6,3,7,4,8], exactly matching the independent reference; this does not exercise ModelSlim, Ascend, loading, serving, or accuracy.
Ascend tooling/CANN and the reported checkpoint are absent.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950, ROCm 7.2) executed a synthetic tensor-order check. This architecture differs from the reported Ascend 910/CANN environment and provides no end-to-end issue verification.

remaining_counterexamples: The candidate's complete regression passes on the recorded base, so it cannot demonstrate a candidate fix.
The candidate has no production or native-code change relative to the recorded base.
No test loads the reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim checkpoint or verifies its actual tensor names, shapes, ordering, and scale metadata.
No test measures generated-token equivalence or semantic accuracy for MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8.
No test executes the Ascend/CANN load and serving path or the reported two-node TP32/DP4 topology.
remaining_limitations: The private/reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 checkpoint is unavailable.
No Ascend device, npu-smi, or /usr/local/Ascend CANN installation is present.
Only one gfx950 GPU is assigned, not the reported 64-device two-node topology.
The synthetic CPU/GPU checks establish only internal tensor-layout behavior already present on the base.
No native source changed; no native rebuild was applicable.
